note: First-party, reproducible OWASP Benchmark v1.2 result for Zennoxa Shield. Shield-only — contains no competitor data.

tool.name: Zennoxa Shield
tool.all_binary_checksums: See SHA256SUMS on the v0.2.0 GitHub release.

benchmark.score_metric: Youden's J (True Positive Rate - False Positive Rate); higher is better

reproduce: Install the Shield CLI v0.2.0 (see the release page) and verify its checksum against SHA256SUMS.
Score shield.sarif against BenchmarkJava/expectedresults-1.2.csv using OWASP's own published scoring tooling.
reproducibility_note: Every figure here is produced by the downloadable v0.2.0 CLI on the public OWASP suite. To compare other tools, use OWASP's own published scorecards; all tools should be run at default configuration.
